title: Uwell Crown X Empty Replacement Pods 2ml - 2 Pack
description: These Uwell Crown X Empty Replacement Pods are a perfect match for your Crown X Pod Kit, offering a seamless vaping experience with a focus on flavour and cloud production. Each pod in this pack of two boasts a 2ml e-liquid capacity, allowing you to enjoy extended vaping sessions without constant refills. These pods are expertly designed to support DTL (Direct to Lung) and RDTL (Restricted Direct to Lung) vaping styles, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. Compatible with high-VG e-liquids , these pods promise dense, flavourful clouds and a smooth throat hit, especially when used with Uwell X Coils. The Uwell Crown X Empty Replacement Pods maintain the brand's commitment to quality and user satisfaction. While coils are not included, these pods are compatible with a range of Uwell X sub-ohm coil options, offering you the freedom to customise your vaping experience according to your taste and preferred style. Their snap-fit mouthpiece makes it easy to refill and swap out flavours, making your device hassle-free, and ensuring you're always ready for a fresh and satisfying vape experience. Whether you're at home or on the go, the Uwell Crown X Empty Replacement Pods maintain your vape experience with the performance you’ve come to expect from Uwell.
